_: NOMAD rules — action resolution. v0.0.1 PLACEHOLDER. References: onen-play/docs/core-gameplay-v9.md and NOMAD-Plex0-Implementation.md. Core formula: outcome = CF (Character Force, from stats + advantages) + SF (Situation Force, environmental factors) + dice − difficulty (default 5). Action classes: SIMPLE (auto-success), RISKY (self-risk), COMBAT_NPC (character vs NPC), COMBAT_PC (character vs character; uses combat_type matrix of mutual/offensive/defensive). Outcome bands: >10 overwhelming · 5-10 clear · 0-5 marginal · 0 stalemate · -5 to 0 minor fail · -10 to -5 significant · <-10 catastrophic. Damage application per action class.
